name: Extra Aura of Protection
body:
Your faith has been rewarded with the ability to protect yourself or others more often.

Prerequisites: Aura of protection class feature.

Benefits: You gain two additional uses of the Aura of Protection ability per day. You may take this feat more than once, granting more uses of this ability.
